column3: The admin session and the OAuth state are cookies by design (the cluster's OAuth pattern): HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, __Host- prefixed. The session value is an HMAC-signed email and expiry, not a credential to protect from its own holder; the state is single-use and short-lived. Accepted 2026-10-13 (D-075).
